properties/path: Path of the file read with read_hashlines, subject to the current Workspace Access mode.
properties/revision: The complete-file SHA-256 revision copied from the read_hashlines result these anchors came from.
properties/edits: 1-100 edits, all against that same original revision, applied together in one write.
properties/edits/items/properties/op: replace the start line or range, or insert_before/insert_after the start line.
properties/edits/items/properties/start: Anchor copied exactly from read_hashlines, such as 12:3f9a0c1b2d.
properties/edits/items/properties/end: Optional inclusive end anchor for replace; omit for insertions.
properties/edits/items/properties/lines: Replacement source lines without anchor labels or CR/LF; empty with replace deletes the range.
